name: SYNTHETIC Profile D - Junior Data Analyst
summary: SYNTHETIC early-career candidate with approximately 2 years of data reporting and analysis experience, using SQL, Python and Power BI to prepare reliable reports and communicate findings to business stakeholders.

professional_experience.title: Junior Reporting Analyst (Dec 2024-present)
responsibilities: Write SQL queries and use Python with pandas to clean, validate and combine weekly sales and inventory extracts; log data-quality issues for review.
Maintain Power BI dashboards and recurring operational reports, documenting metric definitions and checking totals against source files before publication.

Discuss reporting needs with sales and operations stakeholders, clarify unusual results and present concise trend summaries; automated a recurring data-preparation step that reduced preparation time by about 3 hours per month.

career_interests: Improving data quality and reporting processes
